roles.SELECTION: used for model/parameter/threshold selection or error analysis
roles.EVALUATION: target metric computed and revealed on it

experiments.E006: split folds.folio_fold (sha256(folio) % 5); dev {0,1,2} = SELECTION (grammar/threshold development), holdout {3,4} = EVALUATION (revealed)
experiments.E007: split efold (sha256('E007:'+folio) % 5); global prequential + 5-fold cross-fitted scores on ALL folios = EVALUATION; dev {0,1,2} also SELECTION (A8 slot-length profile); dev->holdout arm revealed
experiments.E008: same split; dev {0,1,2} = SELECTION (W chosen on development); holdout {3,4} = EVALUATION
experiments.E008_exploratory: post-reveal exploratory backoff-coder analysis (exploratory.py) trained on dev {0,1,2} and scored on holdout {3,4}; its result motivated the E011 design => error analysis = SELECTION for ALL running-text folios (recorded 2026-10-19)
experiments.E001-E005: historical exploratory analyses (not reproducible from this repo); conservatively assumed to have touched any running-text token

DEVELOPMENT_POOL_RUNNING_V1.description: All 206 running-text folios. Every one carries a SELECTION role (E006/E007/E008 development folds, or the E008 post-reveal exploratory backoff analysis on the E007 holdout folds). Usable for development and internally cross-fitted development-stage estimates; NEVER as a Gate v2 confirmation lockbox.

LOCKBOX_NONRUNNING_V1.description: Label/circular/radial loci (locus type not P*). No committed experiment coded them. Small, structurally different from running text; suitable for transfer-style confirmation only.

statement: NO running-text lockbox exists in ZL3b: every running-text folio was used for selection or error analysis by E006, E007, E008 or the E008 post-reveal exploratory analysis. Running-text claims can only be developed here (internal cross-fitting, development-stage labels). Gate v2 confirmation requires data outside ZL3b running text: LOCKBOX_NONRUNNING_V1 (labels/circular/radial, 710 tokens, transfer-style only), or new sources registered by a human (e.g. a future transliteration release with independent readings).
